race.description: Bryant's Pies Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: JENNI MOO MOO (3) is a twelve-start maiden who finds an easier contest from the low draw. Savaged the line from the wide gate with a narrow second over 1020m at Moruya. Tempo and jump in trip suits. THE LOCAL (8) three-year-old Acrobat gelding from Musicmaker on debut for the Matt Dale yard. Has impressed in all his trials, including the latest 1050m win at Randwick. Drawn out in a very thin contest. Go close. THE FRISKEE FLASH (9) played up before the start on debut and was slow into stride before chipping away late to run fifth over 1020m at Moruya. Fitter now and looks well placed with the claim. Each-way contender. BOLD CONQUER (6) Xtravagant gelding from Can She Kiss on debut for the Scott Cowlings stable. Finished runner-up in both Goulburn trials and not to be underestimated.
